introHtml: Cotton poly blends offer the breathability of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them ideal for babies and toddlers items that need to withstand frequent washing and active play. Whether you're outfitting a daycare or creating a welcome gift for new parents, these custom pieces hold their shape and color wash after wash. Choose screen printing or embroidery for your logo on onesies, bibs, or blankets.
